title: Patch: hide keywords that do nothing on the field from units on the board
notes: A unit on the board no longer draws a chip or a treatment for Equip, Tradable, Cloaked, Crater, Flashback, Stack or Temporary, keywords that do nothing once it is on the field (R2577000, amending R438); its hover preview and inspect sheet still list every keyword. How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Units on the board show only the keywords that work there
changes: A Unit on the board no longer shows Equip, Tradable, Cloaked, Crater, Flashback, Stack or Temporary, which do nothing once it is in play. Its preview still lists every keyword.
